remarks: Spacious and beautifully updated, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse offers exceptional square footage across three fully finished levels - blending comfort, style, and functionality. Inside, you'll find a bright, open floor plan with hardwood floors throughout the main level. The renovated kitchen features stainless steel appliances and flows effortlessly into sun-filled living and dining spaces - perfect for entertaining or relaxing at home. Upstairs, the oversized primary suite includes a private ensuite bath, while two additional bedrooms and a second full bath offer ample space for family, guests, or a home office. With updated bathrooms and new utilities, this home is truly move-in ready. The walk-out lower level provides flexible bonus space - ideal for a family room, gym, media space, or remote work setup - and includes access to a private attached garage and laundry area. Located in a well-maintained, pet-friendly complex with expansive green space, an in-ground pool, and a pool house. All just minutes from downtown Stamford, Metro-North, I-95, shopping, dining, and parks.
